tweet.text:
Agents frequently give up on tasks without thoroughly exploring possible solutions. Although this can happen in reasonable-seeming situations when an agent runs out of ideas, it often happens abruptly in the middle of reasonable efforts.

Full post here: https://metr.github.io/autonomy-evals-guide/gpt-4o-report/
